question:
In the given figure, line a is parallel to line b. Find the value of x.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bc5ac353216e5176d65264e0a6f84e0e90ff08dd7e7324a013c4fe9e54f34dd.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc9c1252f669ab09611e7d05fc84c29c89553f178928191826e9d85318e6d72f.png] 

⇒ 96° = A ( corresponding angles)

⇒ ∠ A = (6x - 36)° (Vertically opposite angle)

⇒ 96° = (6x - 36)°

⇒ 6x = 132

⇒ x = 22°

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
